name: Celldex Therapeutics, Inc.

catalysts.headline: Celldex announces positive Phase 3 EMBARQ-CSU1 and EMBARQ-CSU2 topline results for barzolvolimab in chronic spontaneous urticaria: met primary endpoint (UAS7 change) and all key secondary endpoints at Week 12 across both dose regimens in ~1,939-2,000 patients; complete response rates ~42%-46% vs ~9%-13% placebo at Week 12, rising to 54% by Week 24; BLA submission targeted for 2027
catalysts.impact: 'sell the news' reversal -- stock fell sharply intraday despite positive data; reported magnitude ranges from about -10% to -37%+ depending on measurement point (see conflicts)

catalysts.headline: H.C. Wainwright raised price target on Celldex to $64 from $42 (maintained Buy) following the Phase 3 data, implying ~90% upside

Celldex reports Q2 2026 results: R&D expense $67.5M, G&A $13.1M, net loss $73.5M (-$0.94/share); no material revenue; cash/investments sufficient into 2028; flagged CSU Phase 3 and other barzolvolimab data due Sept./Oct. 2026
catalysts.impact: set up expectations for the Phase 3 readout

catalysts.headline: Celldex reports Phase 2 prurigo nodularis (PN) study of barzolvolimab MISSED primary endpoint (WI-NRS >=4-point improvement at Week 12) and key secondary endpoints, despite rapid tryptase suppression; company is discontinuing the PN program
Celldex closed a $345M public offering (11,896,750 shares at $29.00/share, including full underwriter over-allotment) to fund the barzolvolimab pipeline
catalysts.impact: dilutive but bolstered cash to $717.6M by Q2 2026

conflicts: Same-day decline magnitude reported very inconsistently: MarketBeat cites -$4.19 to $33.70 (~-11%); a separate same-day alert cites -5.1% (-$1.92) to $35.97; TradingView headline says stock 'slumps 11%'; RTTNews headline says stock 'falls 17%'; other coverage variously describes shares as 'crashing nearly 20%,' 'sliding,' 'plummeting,' or down '10.4% in mid-day trading.' Earlier reporting described a premarket spike to ~$41.62 that reversed intraday to as low as ~$23.86 (a ~-37% to -43% swing from the premarket peak) -- not independently corroborated but retained given the disagreement. None of these figures are reconciled to a single canonical close.

Market capitalization conflict: one source cites ~$3.26B-$3.27B (dated on/around Aug 19, 2026, pre-move); a calculated figure using the $33.70 close x 78.53M shares outstanding is ~$2.65B. Given the reported intraday range, the actual closing market cap is uncertain.
Short interest as % of float cited as both 11.2% and 11.36% by different trackers, with unclear and possibly differing settlement dates.
